audit.why: 50.94% over 2511 games is a genuine coin-flip; EVEN at 5.5/10 matches. The difficulty is concentrated in levels 3-6 where her dashes and pack outrange your kite.
audit.corrected: Lane is even overall but you are behind from level 3 to your first item and ahead at 1-2 and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] carry the wrong stage labels, and both cite 'Pack Your Bags', which is not one of Naafiri's abilities.
audit.why: Row 4 is Level 6 and row 5 is First item. Her level-6 tool is Hounds' Pursuit (110/95/80s), a lock-on dash that recasts and shields on the second cast. Her W is The Call of the Pack (26/24/22/20/18s), which makes her untargetable.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Hounds' Pursuit lock-on plus recast; First item = The Call of the Pack untargetability eats your burst window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability 'Pack Your Bags' and a fabricated 'pack of Akita'. The two interactions that actually decide the lane are absent: her untargetability windows and her pack heal.
audit.why: The Call of the Pack (W) and Eviscerate (E) both grant untargetability, which deletes a locked-on Comeuppance and dodges your passive's third hit. Eviscerate (E, 11/10/9/8/7s) fully heals her packmates, so chip trades reset for free unless you hold Grievous Wounds. Her packmates leap onto the first champion Darkin Daggers (Q) hits, so the daggers are the trigger, not the damage. Hounds' Pursuit reveals nearby enemies on a takedown, which strips your Going Rogue camouflage after she gets a kill.
audit.corrected: Do not fire Comeuppance while The Call of the Pack or Eviscerate can go off — both make her untargetable and waste a 100/85/70-second ultimate. Buy Grievous Wounds before her second item: Eviscerate full-heals the pack every 7 seconds at rank 5. Sidestep Darkin Daggers and the packmates never get their leap.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flags zero sequencing cues — no 'wait for X before Y' anywhere.
audit.why: Her punishable cooldown is Eviscerate at 11s rank 1; her commit is Hounds' Pursuit at 110s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Step up only once Eviscerate is spent, and take the extended fight after she burns Hounds' Pursuit — 110 seconds at rank 1 is more than a wave.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged wants.you[1] 'Use Heroic Swing' as a suspect name.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is Akshan's real E. False positive.

edits.after: Level 1: your auto-Q string and the passive's extra shot beat her two daggers.

edits.before: Level 2: same even footing continues before either power spike.
edits.after: Level 2: still yours — Eviscerate is not up yet, so she cannot close.

edits.before: Levels 4-5: her all-in combo continues to out-trade your poke at close range.
edits.after: Levels 4-5: Eviscerate full-heals her packmates, so your chip trades reset.

edits.before: Levels 4-5: Pack Your Bags packmates extend her all-in reach, keeping this phase hers.
edits.after: Level 6: Hounds' Pursuit locks on and recasts, so she chains through your swing.

edits.before: Level 6: the second dash from her ultimate lets her chain through your disengage attempts.
edits.after: First item: The Call of the Pack goes untargetable through the beat you need to burst.

edits.before: Naafiri's pack of Akita spawns from Eviscerate makes level 3-5 all-ins brutal — she can dash through minions to close distance instantly, so hold Heroic Swing to reposition rather than trade face to face.
edits.after: Naafiri's packmates leap onto the first champion Darkin Daggers hits, which makes level 3-5 all-ins brutal — she closes with Eviscerate through minions, so hold Heroic Swing to reposition rather than trade face to face.

edits.after: Hounds' Pursuit locks on and recasts for a second dash and a shield, letting her chain through your kite attempts; respect this window and play for wave state instead of a stand-and-fight.

edits.before: She's still ahead here since her dash-heavy combo out-trades your Q-W poke at close range, but Youmuu's active at least lets you disengage cleanly once the fight goes bad.
edits.after: She's still ahead since her dash-heavy combo out-trades your Q strings at close range, so buy Grievous Wounds — Eviscerate full-heals her whole pack every 7s at rank 5.

edits.before: From level 3 through her level 6 spike with Pack Your Bags, Naafiri wins straight fights — her dash-reset combo closes distance faster than you can kite, so play for wave management and roams instead of contesting her all-in windows.
edits.after: From level 3 through her level 6 spike with Hounds' Pursuit, Naafiri wins straight fights — Eviscerate closes on an 11s cooldown faster than you can kite, so play for wave management and roams instead of contesting her all-in windows.

edits.before: Use Pack Your Bags to close gaps you try to kite with
edits.after: Use The Call of the Pack to go untargetable mid-trade

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Naafiri wins by locking Hounds’ Pursuit, letting the pack chew while Eviscerate heals them, then recasting it for the shield.

edits.before: Carry through strings and executes — chip everything, finish anything under a third, and let the swing write angles no one wards.
edits.after: Carry by refusing her collapse: string her from max range, buy Grievous Wounds against Eviscerate's pack heal, and R only what has already fled.
